RegistrationInfo.Author: war_room_operator
RegistrationInfo.Description: Daily WarRoom audit-runner pre-flight. Runs `bin\install_ALL_TASKS_AUDIT.bat` at 06:00 every day via `bin\dist\run_audit_subprocess.exe` (the fup-3 cross-platform deadlock-free wrapper, PACKAGED via PyInstaller --onefile in cont.16-fup-6 so Python is NOT required at runtime). Output redirected to `tmp\_wrap_out.txt` (auto-ISO-timestamped via --log-timestamp). Install with `bin\install_AUDIT_scheduler.bat` (elevated cmd.exe). Build the .exe ONCE via `bin\build_audit_exe.bat --rebuild` before first install. 1 minute before WarRoomNightlySnapshot (23:55) and WarRoomDailyTrendCompare (23:59) so audit failures surface during the day instead of breaking the overnight pipeline chronologically.
